title: The Wheel
description: Why reinvent the wheel? Opinionated foundation to be used as a starting point for custom modpack creation or as an enhanced and lightweight client for vanilla.
body:
# About

Every new modpack has to start somewhere. So why reinvent the wheel?

This pack strives to provide a stable and performant foundation on which new modpacks can be based. Also sutiable as a snappy vanilla+ client on its own. Contains the standard suite of Sodium and Sodium-compatible performance mods, recipe menu, looking-at probe, mod menu, options management, and of course, AppleSkin :3

From there, a lightweight selection of GUI/HUD changes, texture modifications, visual enhancements, and quality of life features are added. These are based on the preferences and opinions of the pack author – this unified vision being what sets this apart from similar pack options.

## Performance

The pack is developed and tested on an eight-year-old PC with an i7-6700k and 980ti, and it targeted to perform with good frame-rate on similar systems or better, when using the recommended settings.

Pack is worked on and balanced around a healthy 6144MB/6GB of RAM, but you should easily be able to get away with as little as 2GB.

JVM Arguments:
```
-XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:G1NewSizePercent=20 -XX:G1ReservePercent=20 -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=50 -XX:G1HeapRegionSize=32M
```

**Notice:** RAM and JVM settings are not applied automatically by the pack/launcher. You must enable them yourself in the pack options menu in Modrinth.
